system.description:
With a healer's touch you read the life force thrumming beneath a subject's skin, judging what she is, how she suffers and what ails her.

You must touch your subject; no challenge is needed. Spend Mental Traits to unearth information, the effects being cumulative: one Trait reveals whether she is mortal, vampire, ghoul or other; two reveals how much damage she has taken; three reveals how much blood is in her system; and four reveals any diseases. The same touch also serves for medical diagnosis at a cost of one Mental Trait per condition examined, revealing the source and severity of any wound, illness or unnatural mental state.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
